public_rationale: The March 2024 relations experiment reports 45% image–prompt agreement for DALL-E 3, compared with a cited 16.9% for DALL-E 2 on similar relations prompts [e1]. Those results do not measure improvement on the authors' part-specification prompts [e1]. The November 10, 2024 record calls the first cat-with-human-hands attempt arguably correct and the second correct, illustrating the need to separate initial and post-feedback scoring [e2]. Neither item establishes the size of the gain on matched October 2022 and November 2024 part-specification outputs [e1, e2].
limitations: The packet lacks an independent audit of the complete matched output sets under common scoring rules.
Different sampling and feedback procedures limit comparison.
The tally discrepancy does not establish whether improvement was slight or substantial, and no threshold for 'slight' is specified.
